record.question: I am very tired for I have been walking all the morning.
record.explanation: Answer C: compound sentence. The clauses “I am very tired” and “I have been walking…” are independent, joined by for; compound (C). Independent check: “For” joins two independent clauses as a coordinating conjunction (“because”), so the sentence is compound. Reference: https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/conjunctions. Verified worked solution, unofficial.
